page.overview:
Who is Sludge?

Sludge is a male dragon who appears as the antagonist of the season eight episode Father Knows Beast, pretending to be Spike's father. He is named Shale in some merchandise.

Sludge partly resembles "Clump" and to a lesser extent Backdraft.

Sludge shares his name with the G1 character [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-anNhcOzLmU Sludge] in My Little Pony's The Quest of the Princess Ponies.

Regarding the name "Shale", Nicole Dubuc stated on Twitter in October 2018, "Sludge had A LOT of names before we got one to clear legal."
